rule.text: A district appears when its PKD sections employ at least 1.25 times the national share of workers (location quotient) and at least 1,000 people or 1% of the town's workers, or when one of its sections alone is at least 3 times the national share with 1,000 workers. Districts are ranked by workers above the national norm (workers - workers / LQ), up to 5. Workers are counted where the employer is (GUS, 2025-12-31), per powiat.
rule.scope_note: GUS publishes workers by PKD section per powiat: a town without powiat rights shows its whole powiat.

badges.label: Port city
badges.rule: A seaport (pl_transport_ports) within 10 km of the town.

badges.label: Copper town
badges.rule: A copper mine or smelter (pl_mines) within 15 km.

badges.label: Coal town
badges.rule: A hard coal or lignite mine (pl_mines) within 15 km.

badges.label: Refinery town
badges.rule: A crude oil refinery in the town. Not awarded yet: no refinery dataset is in the pipeline.

badges.label: Auto city
badges.rule: Car making (PKD division 29) far above the national share. Not awarded: GUS publishes sections, not divisions, per powiat.

badges.label: Tech city
badges.rule: Information and communication (PKD J) at least 2 times the national share of workers and at least 4% of them.

badges.label: University town
badges.rule: University students equal to at least 10% of residents (GUS, 2025-12-31).

badges.label: Tourist town
badges.rule: Accommodation and food service (PKD I) at least 2 times the national share of workers.

badges.label: Industrial town
badges.rule: Mining and manufacturing (PKD B, C) at least 1.5 times the national share of workers.

badges.label: Garrison town
badges.rule: A military unit HQ or base (pl_soc_military) within 5 km of the town.

catalog.name: Campus
catalog.description: Information and communication, professional and scientific work, and education (PKD J, M, P).

catalog.name: Commercial hub
catalog.description: Trade, finance, real estate and business services (PKD G, K, L, N).

catalog.name: Harbor
catalog.description: Transport and storage (PKD H), shown as a harbor only in towns with a seaport within 10 km.
catalog.caveat: Inland towns with many transport jobs (logistics parks) do not get a harbor.

catalog.name: Aqueduct & power
catalog.description: Electricity, gas and heat supply, water and waste (PKD D, E).

catalog.name: Encampment
catalog.description: A military unit or base in the town (pl_soc_military).
catalog.caveat: Not from PKD jobs: GUS counts soldiers in section O with civil servants.
